scope: Bounded generated typed-length5014 diagnostics for complete AVP framing; pure Go, no persistence.

priority_selection.reason: Batch99 prioritized typed-length5014 with exact-instance evidence and explicit separation from framing, resource and manual-domain errors.

assertions: 5014 requires generated invalid-instance metadata plus a fixed wire-type name. The walker independently rechecks length on the original selected instance.
u32/i32/time require four payload bytes; u64/i64 require eight. Current TBCD accepts one through eight bytes; in-bound digit/nibble errors retain5004.

Address covers missing family bytes and IPv4/IPv6 widths including the two-byte family. Other families remain opaque; family-zero, empty opaque-family data and manual subset restrictions gain no length mapping.
The quote preserves exact leaf header/data/padding and minimal ancestor headers, including repeated parent offsets. Metadata retains no request bytes. Sentinels and FieldError paths remain available.
Source framing, field/count/depth/repeated limits and full reply grammar/reservations bound output. Failed-AVP wrapper consumes ordinary limits; malformed/untrusted/resource inputs remain closed.
TCP/TLS normal/emergency rejection preserves Session/Proxy envelopes, prevents invalid delivery, retains held charges and accepts following valid work; Close/Wait retires charges.
Generated external code uses only public imports; a synthetic consumer validates all seven type names and opaque Address-family behavior.
Existing5004/5001/5005/5009 regression and nine bounded fuzz targets remain included. No zero-filled repair or framing resynchronization is added.
